summary: For HA hub using network storage on the hub nodes themselves, install firewalld and open the storage service ports before installing: `dnf install firewalld`, `firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=<service>` (list with `firewall-cmd --get-services`), then `firewall-cmd --reload`.
questions: How do I open firewall ports for NFS on automation hub nodes?
Do I need firewalld for HA automation hub?
firewall-cmd add service for shared storage

answer_card.title: Open storage ports for HA hub
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
dnf install firewalld
firewall-cmd --get-services                 # find your storage service, e.g. nfs
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=<service>
firewall-cmd --reload
```
Do this on the hub nodes before running the installer.
